subject: KernLabs private offer: evaluation plan, procurement asks, and target close timeline
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <procurement@kernlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: KernLabs private offer: evaluation plan, procurement asks, and target close timeline

Hi Dana —

Really appreciate the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a lightweight Mutual Action Plan (attached) that aligns the evaluation checkpoints, acceptance criteria, and procurement milestones for the AWS private offer. High level: we recommend a 6-week staged eval with a technical sign-off gate and a final business acceptance.

Key pieces in the attached MAP:
- Week 0: Private offer acceptance & initial billing path agreed (PO or Marketplace invoice path)
- Week 1–3: Performance & integration sprint (test harness, latency/cost baselines)
- Week 4: Trial run with production-like data (security checklist & KV-cache validation)
- Week 5: Technical acceptance sign-off (engineering test cases pass)
- Week 6: Business acceptance and commitment (purchase order or signed invoice instruction)

Can you confirm the procurement items you need from Legal/Finance to surface the private offer in your systems? Specifically we typically get: PO template, invoice billing contact, any procurement-specific T&C redlines, and a target date to have the PO issued. If you share the PO contact and your preferred invoice routing we can generate a pre-filled PO term sheet and route a DocuSign for signature.

Attaching: KernLabs_MAP_Draft_20271201.pdf (MAP), PO_Terms_KernLabs.docx (pre-filled terms), redwood-mpa-checklist.xlsx (internal checklist).

Proposed target close: December 23, 2027 (end of Q4) assuming PO by Dec 9 and technical acceptance by Dec 20. If your procurement window is longer we can stagger the trial or extend the eval.

Next steps: can you confirm procurement contact and whether KernLabs will accept an AWS private offer or prefer an invoice route through Finance?

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0129
From: Dana Liu <procurement@kernlabs.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mellis@kernlabs.com>, KernLabs Finance <finance@kernlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KernLabs private offer: evaluation plan, procurement asks, and target close timeline

Aditya —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear milestones. This looks like a sensible sequence. A few quick procurement items from our side: we need a) an approved vendor W-9 on file, b) our standard PO template with your company T&Cs redlined where needed, c) confirmation of billing cadence (monthly in arrears vs prepaid), and d) confirmation of where invoices should be sent (AP email below).

AP email: ap-payments@kernlabs.com
PO owner: me (procurement@kernlabs.com)
Legal: looping Mark for contract redlines — Mark, please review sections 7 (data handling) and 12 (indemnity) and flag any non-starters.

Regarding private offer vs invoice route: Procurement preference is private offer (AWS private offer) so we can track in our central marketplace ledger, but Finance will need an invoice route as a fallback if the private offer can't be completed before 12/9.

Timeline constraints: we need PO on or before Dec 9 to hit your Dec 23 target. If redlines push beyond Dec 9, we'll accept a staged PO for an initial pilot (up to $15k) and finalize the larger commitment after business acceptance.

I’ll review the attached PO_Terms_KernLabs.docx with Mark and AP and come back with any edits by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Dana Liu
Senior Procurement Manager, KernLabs
procurement@kernlabs.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <procurement@kernlabs.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KernLabs private offer: evaluation plan, procurement asks, and target close timeline

Dana —

Looping in billing details so Finance has the routing options up front. AP email confirmed above (ap-payments@kernlabs.com) — good. A couple notes on our side:
- For private offers we can push an AWS Marketplace invoice that maps to your ledger; that typically shows as a single vendor invoice and can be routed to AP.
- If Finance needs a monthly invoice cadence we can set up monthly billing in arrears; otherwise we support upfront/prepaid via private offer credit.
- For the staged PO option we can accept a pilot PO for $15k and hold the final SKU/pricing tables for the larger commitment once business acceptance is reached.

I attached the redwood-mpa-checklist.xlsx which maps deliverables to invoice/PO triggers and includes the canonical invoice line items we use for private offers. That should speed AP reconciliation.

Let me know if you want a short call later today to align on the legal redlines + PO signatory.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sales Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <procurement@kernlabs.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mellis@kernlabs.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KernLabs private offer: evaluation plan, procurement asks, and target close timeline

Thanks all — quick alignment from the AE side.

We’ll do the following to keep the Q4 close achievable:
- Aditya: send the pre-filled DocuSign (PO + private offer acceptance) by EOD today so Dana/Mark can review and sign.
- Laura: confirm invoice line items and whether we should default to monthly arrears for KernLabs (unless Finance explicitly requests prepaid).
- Jonas (solutions): will prepare the test harness instructions and a short checklist of the exact perf tests we expect to run in Weeks 1–3. Jonas, please share by EOD tomorrow.

If procurement and legal can complete redlines by Dec 8 we’ll submit the private offer to AWS on Dec 9 and expect invoice/commit routing to be active the following week. If we hit that cadence, technical acceptance by Dec 20 and business sign on Dec 23 is still viable. Otherwise we’ll accept the pilot PO path (Aditya noted details).

On the legal asks — Mark, if you can mark up PO_Terms_KernLabs.docx with change-tracking and return to procurement@kernlabs.com + aditya@redwood.com that will keep the thread tidy.

One more note: if KernLabs needs an SOC 2 attestation or a short data-handling appendix, we can attach our standard security addendum to the private offer; let us know and I’ll route it.

Appreciate the speedy turnaround — moving to a short call only if you want it. Otherwise we’ll proceed async.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Account Execs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
--- End of thread ---
